company.name: KitchenomiKs
company.shortDescription: Oman-born hybrid food infrastructure platform — scaling food brands, cloud kitchens, KaaS, and enterprise F&B across Oman and the GCC.
company.description:
KitchenomiKs is an Oman-born hybrid FoodTech and food infrastructure platform founded in March 2022 and headquartered at the Oman Convention & Exhibition Centre (OCEC), Muscat.
Built on 30,000 sq ft of central production infrastructure and six satellite kitchens across Muscat, KitchenomiKs operates across five business lines: proprietary multi-brand cloud kitchens, the Johnny Rockets franchise, Kitchen-as-a-Service (KaaS) for third-party operators, smart food courts and grab-and-go formats, and enterprise and event food service.
The platform runs 13+ virtual and physical food brands, has served over one million meals, and has deployed $6.7M into kitchen infrastructure, technology, brands, and operating capacity since founding.
KitchenomiKs is technology-led — using proprietary systems for demand forecasting, kitchen scheduling, quality management, and multi-brand operations across every kitchen and channel. The platform also supports Omani SMEs, local suppliers, and emerging F&B entrepreneurs, generating real In-Country Value aligned with Oman Vision 2040.
The company is actively expanding its grab-and-go format through fuel-station and convenience-store partnerships in Oman, with GCC expansion underway.
KitchenomiKs is open to strategic investors, international brand partners, and GCC operators looking to scale food businesses through shared infrastructure.
